name: NCAA D-III Metro Regional Cross Country Championships
where: Bethlehem, PA · host Moravian · Lehigh Goodman Campus Course
headline: NCAA D-III Metro Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: No. 22 Haverford won the men’s title with 23 points over TCNJ (57) behind a 1-2 from Owen Bluman (25:02.0) and Simon Lane. Swarthmore won the women’s race with 43 points ahead of TCNJ (83), and Swarthmore’s Charlotte Martin won by one second over DeSales’ Ellie Kozich in 21:49.8.
